prompt: ___ two clean towels in the bathroom.
explanation: There are acompaña a un sustantivo plural: two towels.

prompt: Mara ___ her bicycle to work every Monday.
explanation: Every Monday indica una rutina. En tercera persona singular se añade -s: rides.

prompt: Please be quiet. The baby ___ now.
explanation: Una acción en curso ahora se expresa con be + verbo en -ing: is sleeping.

prompt: Yesterday, Omar ___ his keys under the sofa.
explanation: Yesterday sitúa la acción terminada en pasado. El pasado irregular de find es found.

prompt: Look at those black clouds. It ___ rain.
explanation: Be going to + infinitivo permite una predicción apoyada en indicios presentes: las nubes.

prompt: The sign says 'Do not touch'. Visitors ___ touch the paintings.
explanation: Must not expresa prohibición. Do not have to indica que no es necesario, no que esté prohibido.

prompt: This bag weighs 3 kg. That bag weighs 8 kg. This bag is ___ than that one.
explanation: Para comparar dos objetos con el adjetivo corto light se usa lighter than.

prompt: The class starts ___ 9:15 on Friday.
explanation: Se usa at con horas concretas y on con días: at 9:15 on Friday.

prompt: There isn't ___ milk left in the bottle.
explanation: En esta oración negativa any acompaña al sustantivo incontable milk. Many y a few se usan con plurales contables.

prompt: Which noun is normally uncountable?
explanation: Advice es incontable: some advice o a piece of advice. Apple, chair y suitcase admiten plural contable.

prompt: If the bus is late tomorrow, I ___ to work.
explanation: El primer condicional expresa una posibilidad futura: if + presente, will + infinitivo.

prompt: You use a ___ to open a locked door.
explanation: Key significa llave y encaja con abrir una puerta cerrada con llave.

prompt: A shop notice says 'Closed on Sundays'. What does it mean?

options.text: The shop opens only on Sunday.
You cannot shop there on Sunday.
The shop is closed every day.
The shop closes later on Sunday.

explanation: Closed on Sundays indica que el establecimiento permanece cerrado los domingos.

prompt: Message from Ana: 'I am at the café. Meet me here at six.' Where should you go?
explanation: Here se refiere al lugar desde el que Ana escribe, el café. La hora de encuentro es las seis.

prompt: Email: 'Your appointment is on Tuesday at 10. Please arrive ten minutes early.' When should you arrive?
explanation: Ten minutes early significa diez minutos antes: el martes a las 9:50, no después de las diez.

prompt: Someone says 'Thank you for your help.' Which reply fits?
explanation: You are welcome es una respuesta natural a un agradecimiento por una ayuda.

prompt: A notebook costs £4. You pay with a £10 note. How much change should you receive?
explanation: Change significa el dinero que te devuelven al pagar: diez menos cuatro son seis libras.

prompt: You arrive at a hotel with a reservation. What do you say at reception?

options.text: I would like to check in.
I would like to take off.
I would like to turn left.
I would like to try these shoes.

explanation: Check in es registrarse al llegar a un hotel. Take off se usa, entre otros sentidos, para despegar.

prompt: Your plane leaves at 14:20. The screen says 'Boarding: Gate 6'. Where should you go?
explanation: Boarding indica embarque y gate significa puerta. Debes dirigirte a la puerta seis.

prompt: You have toothache. Who should you make an appointment with?
explanation: Toothache significa dolor de muelas o dientes. El profesional correspondiente es el dentista.

prompt: Nora works from 8 to 12. She has lunch at home, then works again from 13 to 16. Where does she eat lunch?
explanation: El texto dice has lunch at home. La respuesta se localiza directamente sin deducir dónde trabaja Nora.

prompt: The departure board says 'Train delayed by 15 minutes'. What does delayed mean?
explanation: Delayed significa retrasado. No implica que el tren esté cancelado ni que vaya lleno. Es vocabulario complementario.

prompt: Every weekday, the station ___ at six in the morning.
explanation: Every weekday expresa una rutina; con the station, tercera persona singular, corresponde opens. Open no concuerda; opening necesita auxiliar y opened es pasado.

prompt: Yesterday, we ___ the train because we arrived late.
explanation: Yesterday sitúa el hecho en pasado: missed es el pasado regular de miss. Las otras formas no expresan aquí una acción terminada en pasado.

prompt: The notice says: “Staff only”. Who may enter?
explanation: Staff significa personal: el aviso reserva la entrada a empleados. No autoriza a todos los pasajeros ni indica que nadie pueda entrar.

prompt: The 10:15 bus is cancelled. A replacement bus leaves at 10:45 from stop B. Where should passengers wait for the replacement?
explanation: El aviso dice que el autobús de sustitución sale de stop B. La hora y la cancelación aportan contexto; ninguna de las otras ubicaciones aparece como parada de salida.

prompt:
Read the notice.

RIVER PARK STATION
The lift is out of service until Friday and will reopen on Friday. Passengers with heavy bags can use the ramp beside Platform 2. For help, speak to a member of staff.

On which day will the lift reopen?
explanation: El aviso indica que el ascensor volverá a funcionar el viernes. El jueves es antes de la reapertura, el sábado es un día después y el texto sí especifica la fecha.

prompt:
Read the notice.

RIVER PARK STATION
The lift is out of service until Friday and will reopen on Friday. Passengers with heavy bags can use the ramp beside Platform 2. For help, speak to a member of staff.

Why might a passenger with heavy bags use the ramp?

options.text: It leads directly to the ticket office.
It is an alternative while the lift is unavailable.
A member of staff will carry every bag there.
It is the only route open on Friday.

explanation: El ascensor está fuera de servicio y el aviso recomienda la rampa a quienes llevan equipaje pesado: es la alternativa disponible. No dice que lleve a taquilla, que el personal cargue las bolsas ni que sea la única ruta el viernes.

prompt:
Read the notice.

RIVER PARK STATION
The lift is out of service until Friday and will reopen on Friday. Passengers with heavy bags can use the ramp beside Platform 2. For help, speak to a member of staff.

Which is the best summary of the notice?

options.text: Train times have changed, so passengers should wait outside.
Only station staff may use Platform 2.
The lift is unavailable until Friday; passengers can use the nearby ramp or ask staff for help.
The ramp will close when the lift reopens.

explanation: La opción correcta reúne los datos principales: cuándo vuelve el ascensor, qué alternativa se ofrece y a quién pedir ayuda. El aviso no cambia horarios, no restringe el andén al personal ni dice que la rampa vaya a cerrar.

prompt:
Read the email.

Hi Leo,
I have booked a table for four at Green Café for 7:30 tonight. My bus arrives at 7:20, so please order some water if you get there first. The café is opposite the library.
See you,
Nina

What is Nina mainly doing in this email?

options.text: Asking Leo to cancel a table.
Telling Leo that she cannot come tonight.
Giving Leo directions to the bus station.
Confirming their café plan and explaining what to do if Leo arrives first.

explanation: Nina confirma la cena y añade una instrucción por si Leo llega antes. No cancela la reserva, no dice que falte a la cita ni le da indicaciones para ir a la estación de autobuses.

prompt:
Read the email.

Hi Leo,
I have booked a table for four at Green Café for 7:30 tonight. My bus arrives at 7:20, so please order some water if you get there first. The café is opposite the library.
See you,
Nina

Nina’s bus is due at 7:20 and the table is booked for 7:30. What should Leo do if he gets to the café before her?

options.text: Wait at the bus station until 7:30.
Go into the library to find Nina.

explanation: Nina pide a Leo que encargue agua si llega primero. No le pide esperar en la estación, pedir café ni buscarla dentro de la biblioteca.

prompt:
Read the email.

Hi Leo,
I have booked a table for four at Green Café for 7:30 tonight. My bus arrives at 7:20, so please order some water if you get there first. The café is opposite the library.
See you,
Nina

Leo knows where the library is. Which direction in the email will help him find Green Café?

options.text: It is next to the bus station.

explanation: Opposite significa enfrente de: el café está frente a la biblioteca. No está detrás ni dentro de ella, y el correo no lo sitúa junto a la estación.

prompt:
Read the message.

Hi Sam,
I left your red umbrella with the receptionist at the sports centre. I will be there again on Wednesday after 5, but you can collect it any time before then.
Mia

What is Mia mainly telling Sam?

options.text: Where his umbrella is and when he can collect it.
That she has bought him a new umbrella.
That the sports centre is closed on Wednesday.
That he must meet her at the bus stop.

explanation: Mia explica dónde dejó el paraguas y hasta cuándo puede recogerlo. No dice que haya comprado otro, que el centro cierre el miércoles ni que Sam deba ir a una parada.

prompt:
Read the message.

Hi Sam,
I left your red umbrella with the receptionist at the sports centre. I will be there again on Wednesday after 5, but you can collect it any time before then.
Mia

Does Sam have to wait until Mia returns on Wednesday after 5 to get the umbrella?

options.text: Yes, Mia must hand it to him herself.
Yes, the receptionist is there only after 5.
No, but he can collect it only on Thursday.
No, he can collect it at any time before Mia returns.

explanation: “Any time before then” permite recogerlo antes de que Mia vuelva el miércoles después de las cinco. No hace falta que Mia esté presente; tampoco se restringe la recogida al jueves ni se dice que recepción abra solo después de las cinco.

prompt:
Read the message.

Hi Sam,
I left your red umbrella with the receptionist at the sports centre. I will be there again on Wednesday after 5, but you can collect it any time before then.
Mia

In “I will be there again”, what place does “there” refer to?
explanation: There retoma el lugar que Mia acaba de mencionar: el centro deportivo, donde dejó el paraguas. No se ha mencionado la casa de Sam, una parada de autobús ni una escuela.

prompt:
Read the café information.

HILLTOP CAFÉ
Breakfast: 8:00–10:30
Lunch: 12:00–14:00
Soup is available every day. On Mondays, the café closes at 3:00 for cleaning.

At what time does breakfast finish?
explanation: El horario marca las 10:30 como fin del desayuno. Las 8:00 son el inicio, las 12:00 inicia la comida y las 14:00 termina ese servicio.

prompt:
Read the café information.

HILLTOP CAFÉ
Breakfast: 8:00–10:30
Lunch: 12:00–14:00
Soup is available every day. On Mondays, the café closes at 3:00 for cleaning.

A visitor asks whether soup is served on Sunday. What does the notice tell them?

options.text: Yes. Soup is available every day.
No. Soup is available only on Monday.
No. The café is closed every Sunday.
It does not say whether soup is available.

explanation: Every day incluye el domingo, así que sí hay sopa. El aviso no la limita al lunes, no dice que el café cierre los domingos y sí responde a la pregunta.

prompt:
Read the café information.

HILLTOP CAFÉ
Breakfast: 8:00–10:30
Lunch: 12:00–14:00
Soup is available every day. On Mondays, the café closes at 3:00 for cleaning.

A customer arrives at 14:30 on Monday. Which conclusion follows from the notice?

options.text: The café has not opened yet.
The café is already closed for the day.
The café is still open, but the lunch period has ended.

explanation: A las 14:30 ya terminó la comida, que va hasta las 14:00, pero el café no cierra los lunes hasta las 15:00. Por eso aún está abierto, aunque ya no sea horario de comida.

prompt: Listen! The children ___ a song in the next room.
explanation: Listen! indica que la acción ocurre ahora, por eso se usa are singing. Sing y sings son presente simple, y sang es pasado.

prompt: There ___ a small pharmacy opposite the station.
explanation: El sujeto es singular: a small pharmacy, así que corresponde there is. Are se usa con plural; were es pasado y be no puede aparecer solo en esta estructura.

prompt: You ___ show your ticket before you get on the train; it is a rule.
explanation: La frase dice que es una norma: must expresa obligación. Can habla de capacidad o permiso, might de posibilidad y would no comunica aquí una obligación.

prompt: The blue route is ___ than the red route; it is 2 km, not 5 km.
explanation: Se comparan dos rutas: shorter than es la forma comparativa correcta. Shortest es superlativo, more short no es la forma habitual y the shorter no encaja aquí.

prompt: Our train leaves ___ Monday morning.
explanation: Se usa on con días y partes concretas del día: on Monday morning. At se usa con horas, in con periodos más amplios y by significa “como máximo para”.

prompt: You are looking for a jacket in a larger size. Which question asks whether the shop has one?

options.text: Where can I catch the train?
Do you have this jacket in a larger size?

explanation: La primera pregunta consulta si tienen esa chaqueta en una talla mayor. Las demás preguntan por un tren, la duración de una clase y una reserva de habitación.

prompt: You have a bad toothache. Where should you make an appointment?
explanation: Un dentista atiende problemas de dientes, así que la cita debe ser en una clínica dental. La oficina de correos, la panadería y la estación no ofrecen atención dental.

prompt: Your flight was planned to leave at 18:10. At 18:20 the airport screen says “Delayed — new departure 18:40”. What should you understand?

options.text: Passengers must go to another airport.
The new departure time is later than the original one.

explanation: Delayed indica un retraso: la nueva salida será a las 18:40, después de la hora prevista, 18:10. El mensaje no dice que el avión ya haya salido o llegado ni que cambie de aeropuerto.

prompt: The routes are 2 km, 5 km and 8 km. To name the route with the minimum distance, use a superlative: the ___ of the three.
explanation: Las longitudes son distintas y se pide expresamente el extremo de menor distancia entre tres rutas: después del the que ya aparece en la frase, la forma superlativa es shortest. Shorter es comparativo y no expresa aquí la forma superlativa solicitada; most short no es la formación usual de short, y short no indica el extremo del grupo.

prompt: A traveller asks you to hold her bag while she checks her ticket. You agree: “Of course, I will ___ it.”
explanation: You agree expresa una oferta en el momento; will + verbo base da I will hold. Tras will no se usa to (will to hold), la forma -ing (will holding) ni la terminación -s (will holds).

prompt: I would like ___ about the timetable.
explanation: Information es incontable: puede ir con some, pero no con an, many ni plural -s. Si quieres contar unidades, di two pieces of information.
